item.title: How Bailard became the best RIA to work for
item.description: Paid sabbaticals, employee ownership and a philosophy-first culture have helped Bailard top this year's Best RIAs to Work For list.

item.title: Wealth Enhancement, Apollon secure major deals in busy M&A week: Advisor Moves
item.description: Also, Independent Financial Partners secures a $700M team from Commonwealth/LPL, and NewEdge Capital names a new CEO.

item.title: Want to add estate planning? Start by thinking about fee models
item.description: Steve Lockshin and Michael Kitces tied what they view as some mistaken assumptions around fees to the competitive need for more estate planning services.

item.title: Know Your Niche: From guitar player to advising Nashville's stars
item.description: Troy Von Haefen once shared a stage with Lee Ann Womack. Now he's built a financial advising firm around his Nashville connections.

item.title: Trump executive order seeks to gut state AI laws
item.description: In a move some industry observers call "dangerous and irresponsible," the administration is taking down consumer protection guardrails that have been put up by states like California and Colorado.

item.title: Schwab suit shows risks of giving advance notice of employment termination
item.description: Brett Griffin was given two months' notice that he would lose his job when Charles Schwab closed the office where he was working in Temecula, California. Now the firm accuses him of using some of that time to help move client data to a rival RIA.

item.title: 10 lessons from AI's transformative year in wealth management
item.description: Yes, AI is saving many advisors time and helping them reach prospects. But some say the rapid rate of adoption and automation could put them out of a job in the future.

item.title: Does Focus CEO's exit signal new phase in the firm's consolidation?
item.description: Michael Nathanson oversaw Focus Financial Partners as it reorganized into five internal hubs. Industry experts say the long overdue consolidation still has far to go.

item.title: Could rescheduling make marijuana investments viable?
item.description: President Donald Trump is reportedly considering moving cannabis from a Schedule I to Schedule III substance. Experts say this could go a long way toward establishing the industry's legitimacy.

item.title: How to unbox tax savings with a four-sided options strategy
item.description: An increasingly popular form of lending enables financial advisors and their clients to offset capital gains and find other tax savings.
